Image Pro-Life As State Representative and State Senator in the Missouri Legislature, Congressman Onder has been a steadfast champion of Pro-Life legislation. He is a cosponsor of the Born Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act. The bill requires medical professionals to treat a child that survives an abortion the exact same way they would treat a child born prematurely. He knows the issues intimately and understands the threats to the Right to Life posed by pro-abortion allies and colleagues that exhibit indifference even when confronted by the truth. Image Immigration As a member of the Missouri House, Congressman Onder sponsored and passed HB1549 in 2008 to ban Sanctuary Cities, crack down on public employers and contractors who hire illegal aliens, and end catch-and-release of illegal aliens. The Federation for American Immigration Reform called this the strongest state law in the country to fight illegal immigration. Image 2nd Amendment As a member of Congress, Congressman Onder will vigorously fight on behalf of gun owners and the Second Amendment.  Congressman Onder was a leader in the Missouri State Senate leading to the passage of Constitutional Carry in 2016 and the Second Amendment Preservation Act in 2019. He also sponsored legislation to expand the Castle Doctrine and  allow exercise of one’s constitutional rights on public transit. Bob Onder, Physician and Lawyer, Appointed Pro-Life Caucus Co-Chair June 26, 2025 Press Release WASHINGTON, DC— It was announced today, on the 3 rd  anniversary of the Supreme Court Dobbs decision, which reversed the Roe v. Wade decision of 1973 legalizing abortion on demand, that Rep. Bob Onder (R-MO) will take on a new leadership role in the House of Representatives as a co-Chair of the House Congressional Pro-Life Caucus.    Issues : Pro-Life Congressman Onder Introduces Bill to End the Trafficking of Aborted Babies March 12, 2025 Press Release Washington, D.C. – Congressman Bob Onder (R-MO-03) introduced the Protecting Life and Integrity in Research Act alongside Congressman Chris Smith, Chair of the House Pro-Life Caucus, to defend the dignity of unborn children killed by abortion. This legislation would end taxpayer support of any research using fetal tissue obtained from an abortion as well as the solicitation of such tissue. It would also close any loopholes in the law allowing for the use of body parts obtained via abortion in federally funded research projects. While in Missouri’s State Senate, Congressman Onder supported legislation that allowed families to consider transferring to accredited schools within their district of residence, instead of just leaving their school district altogether. The bill also expanded options for virtual and charter schools to ensure that families have an option to ensure their children’s best possible chances for success. Jobs and Economy | Representative Bob Onder Skip to main content Newsletter Subscribe | Accessibility Jobs and Economy Image The economy and jobs remain the top concern of most constituents, regardless of political ideology. Washington must end its spending addiction and focus its efforts on creating opportunities for job growth. Small business owners throughout the 3rd District are staring down increasing taxes and burdensome government regulations, hindering their ability to create jobs and grow the economy. Congress needs to keep prioritizing efforts to make the tax code fairer and simpler, in the hopes of creating quality, family-sustaining jobs and bigger paychecks for every American. We must continue to reform job training programs and expand education opportunities to give Americans the tools they need to find work. I’ll advocate for efforts to reform and modernize the maze of federal workforce training programs and help unemployed Americans get back to work. Government regulations cost the average American family more than $15,000 each year. I’ve aggressively sought to confront excessive government regulations that act as barriers to stronger private sector growth and job creation. We can't keep spending money we don't have, and we must reduce barriers for real private sector job growth. I’ll remain focused on what we can do right now, and in the long-term, to make a difference in people’s lives.   More on Jobs and Economy Congressman Bob Onder Applauds Passage of the “One Big Beautiful Bill Act,” a Major Win for the American People and President Trump’s Agenda July 7, 2025 Press Release Washington, D.C. — Today, Congressman Bob Onder (R-MO) proudly voted on the successful passage of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, a huge legislative victory that renews critical Trump-era tax cuts, secures America’s borders, and stops the largest tax increase in American history from taking effect. “This is a huge win for the American people and a clear affirmation of the America First agenda,” said Congressman Onder.
